title: Combined Excise Tax Return: State Sales and Use Tax

passages.question: What goes on the state retail sales tax line?
passages.excerpt: This amount must be the same as the gross amount for retailing in your business and occupation tax section. ... Multiply the taxable amount by the tax rate shown (0.065) and write this amount in tax due.

passages.question: Which October purchases owe use tax?
passages.excerpt: Use tax applies to the value of all articles you used in your business (as opposed to being sold to a customer) on which no Washington sales tax has been paid.
